decisions.reason: Operator training builds directly on the firm's established application know-how and training capabilities, so the firm can readily interpret results and refine the programme.
A fourth rotary axis accessory extends the existing machine offer, where the firm's R&D and engineering knowledge allow it to learn from customer feedback and improve the product.

Hybrid additive post-processing lies far from the firm's core milling and dispensing knowledge and was only mentioned on the website, so absorptive capacity for learning from it is limited despite in-house R&D.
A high-speed CNC milling line with several models sits at the core of the firm's expertise and is strongly supported by its R&D, testing and service network.
An automatic tool change system builds on the firm's machine and tooling knowledge and complements its core milling systems, making continued development likely.
